name: zsnd_set_speed_of_sound_mps
description: zSnd::SetSpeedOfSoundMps stores the configured speed of sound and its reciprocal for 3D audio doppler calculations.
known_limits: tier S verification is tracked separately through tools/vc5_verify_targets/zsnd_set_speed_of_sound_mps.json.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a2e80 stores the raw float argument to g_zSndSpeedOfSoundMps and stores 1.0f divided by that argument to g_zSndInvSpeedOfSoundMps.
The native speed-of-sound smoke verifies the setter updates both globals from a configured meters-per-second value.
